tasks.title: Listen, look and write
tasks.objective: Follow two very short classroom instructions, signal non-understanding and request a slow repeat.
tasks.context:
La professeure dit : « Écoutez. Regardez le mot : café. Écrivez café. »
Léa écoute. Elle regarde le mot. Elle écrit café.

Understand: Learn Écoutez, Regardez and Écrivez as classroom chunks. First listen, then look, then write. The accent in café stays in writing. These polite/plural instruction forms are not a full lesson on verb conjugation.

tasks.title: Ask for a slower repeat
tasks.objective: Follow two very short classroom instructions, signal non-understanding and request a slow repeat.
tasks.context:
— Écrivez le mot école.
— Pardon ? Je ne comprends pas. Répétez lentement, s’il vous plaît.
— École.
— Merci.

Understand: Pardon ? signals a problem politely. Je ne comprends pas means I do not understand. Répétez lentement asks for a slow repeat. Learn the complete repair sequence before analysing ne… pas. You can ask for help; guessing is not required.

tasks.title: Integrate and transfer: Understand and repair a first classroom exchange
tasks.objective: Follow two very short classroom instructions, signal non-understanding and request a slow repeat.
tasks.context:
Write a four-line exchange using an invented name if needed. Give one classroom instruction from Input 1, signal that it was not understood, ask for a slow repeat and say thanks. Copy supported phrases first; then hide the model and say the repair request. Ask the Tutor to act as a patient teacher, one instruction at a time.

Review criteria: Supported check: identify the action; preserve café/école accents; use a clear repair request; listen to the repeated instruction. Revisit the model tomorrow before trying a new word.

Use the existing writing workspace to save and revise; voice/Tutor practice is optional and must use your selected level. No automatic mastery or CEFR award.
